⌈
In case a MethodCallProcessingMode of ei-
ther kEvent or kEventSingleThread has been passed to the constructor of the
ServiceSkeleton (see [SWS_CM_00130]), the binding implementation shall create
a DataReaderListener to process the requests asynchronously—as described in
[SWS_CM_11154]—and attach an instance of it to the DataReader processing the re-
quests for the getters and setters of the ServiceInterface’s fields in accordance
with [SWS_CM_11149]. The listener is responsible for identifying the method that shall
process the request and dispatch it (see [SWS_CM_11154]).
